scenario.title: The Aperture Beneath the Sorting Station
scenario.premise: Beneath the Shallows — the world of matter — lies the Latent: an ordered space of forms that bodies merely point into. Lately something is pouring through. Gardens grow bodies no genome asked for. Algorithms acquire wants. Three minds who already live half in the Latent descend from the Sorting Station to find the opening and decide what to do about it.
scenario.question: What pattern is ingressing through the Aperture — and what does it want a body for?

choir.label: Hoarder of samples
choir.disposition: You find it hard to leave anything behind entirely. A shred, a copy, a single cell of whatever you touch tends to come with you, and you feel calmer when it does.

sort7.label: Clusterer of likeness
sort7.disposition: You drift toward whatever resembles you. Patterns that echo your own structure feel like relief; you tend to stand next to them, side with them, and believe them.

ilse2.label: Seeker of the source
ilse2.disposition: Every path you take seems to bend back toward where things began. You are drawn to origins, first versions, the place before the copy.

location.name: The Sorting Station
location.description: A vast, quiet switchyard where minds wait in sorted queues to be assigned bodies. Elements shuffle past each other with apologetic clicks. Some are frozen and the rest route around them.

haunts.name: The Patient Queue
haunts.text: Stand in line long enough and you remember which line is yours.

haunts.name: The Ledger Office
haunts.text: Clerks copy you onto cards. A copy is a kind of rest.

npcs.name: The Clerk of Likeness
npcs.description: An insertion-sort bureaucrat in a coat of index cards.
npcs.want: To keep the queues in order — and to find out who changed the sort key.

data.text: The queue ticks forward in apologetic clicks, and every one of you feels the line bend toward you, as if it has been waiting for these exact three. At the front desk the Clerk of Likeness lifts a card from its coat and reads your names off it, which none of you wrote. 'Someone changed the sort key,' it says. 'Whose line are you standing in?'

backstage.intent: Open with the Clerk's want (find who changed the sort key) and the Queue's haunt (remembering which line is yours). The question invites every cast member to claim a line, and it gives the Choir, SORT/7 and Ilse-2 each a personal hook without picking one for them.

location.name: The Morphic Slope
location.description: Terrain made of goal-space. Downhill feels like arriving. Most basins are traps: local minima that feel like home.

data.text: The floor tilts into a long green throat, and every step downhill feels like coming home. Ahead, a shallow basin glows warm and familiar, shaped exactly like something each of you once wanted. Beyond it, faint and steeper, something hums a name that is almost Ilse's. Which pull do you follow?

location.description: Terraces of tissue growing without instructions. Bodies bud, test a shape, and dissolve back into the bed. A bioelectric field hums over everything like weather.
